question.prompt: Let \(f\) be a function satisfying \(f(xy) = \dfrac{f(x)}{y}\) for all positive real numbers \(x\) and \(y.\) If \(f(500) = 3,\) what is the value of \(f(600)?\)

solutions.explanation:
To use the known value \(f(500)\), choose \(x=500\). We then want \(xy=600\), so take \(y=600/500=6/5\). Both inputs are positive, as required by the identity. Therefore
\[
f(600)=\frac{f(500)}{6/5}
=3\cdot\frac56
=\boxed{\frac52}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Choose inputs giving 600
